{"command":"$root='<repo>-bench\ab-continuation\sandboxes-r7full\formal-case-07-B\workspace\.git\objects';
function Read-Object($hash){
  $p=Join-Path $root ($hash.Substring(0,2)+'\'+$hash.Substring(2))
  $raw=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p)
  # git loose objects: zlib stream. skip 2-byte header; inflate rest (ignore adler32)
  $ms=New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream(,$raw[2..($raw.Length-1)])
  $ds=New-Object System.IO.Compression.DeflateStream($ms,[System.IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)
  $sr=New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($ds)
  $text=$sr.ReadToEnd()
  $sr.Close(); $ds.Close(); $ms.Close()
  return $text
}
$commit=Read-Object 'a247e75ab9e78cce7853e3f281b85459a4f25e7c'
Write-Output $commit"}
